notes: Sanofi paid ~$3.68B all-cash for Principia Biopharma, whose lead asset rilzabrutinib is an oral, reversible covalent BTK inhibitor for immune-mediated diseases (pemphigus, immune thrombocytopenia / ITP, IgG4-related disease). Sanofi already partnered with Principia on a separate CNS-penetrant BTK program (tolebrutinib for MS); the buyout consolidated full rights. Peak-sales figure of $1.0B is a sell-side ESTIMATE across the immune-mediated indications — not a Sanofi-disclosed number. EV/peak of ~3.68x reflects an oral BTK inhibitor with multiple immunology indications but earlier commercial visibility than the S1P comps.
selection_rationale: Oral BTK-inhibitor autoimmune small-molecule M&A with public deal terms. Diversifies the autoimmune · small_molecule cohort beyond the S1P-modulator pair (Arena/etrasimod, Receptos/ozanimod) with a distinct oral immunology mechanism.
source: Sanofi/Principia press release Aug 17 2020; Principia SEC filings. Peak-sales is a sell-side consensus ESTIMATE (not company-disclosed).
